Text: You undergo bariatric surgery. Ouch! Your diabetes goes away and you lose a ton of weight. Sad!
You run out of Wegovy and immediately put on all the weight you had lost. Success at last!
Angiogram finds stable disease in the distal circumflex artery which is stented on sight! Cosmetic triumph!
You ditch atorvastatin for cinnamon bark capsules after watching a clip on natural remedies in TikTok. So liberating!
Your angiogram showed only minor disease and you celebrate with a bucket of extra crispy fried chicken.
Your neighbor tells you statins are harmful and when you stop that tablet you have a stroke leading to admission for a week. Way to go!
You quit smoking (oh no!) but put on a huge amount of weight instead. Keep it coming!
Your whole-body CT scan shows a 2 mm lung freckle. The panic sends your BP soaring and you suffer a TIA in the process. Well done!
Your weight makes you breathless but doctors orders you to have an angiogram just to be safe. Health comes first!
Your smartwatch tells you the rhythm is irregular and you end up monitored for 2 days in the telemetry area. Not bad!
Your chest feels uneasy watching a horror movie on Netflix and you call 911, leading to 3 troponins for Movie Panic!
You try celery detox but only last 45 minutes before your craving for pizza takes over and you decides to order delivery. Thadda boy!
You find walking too much work but your doctor gets you a medically prescribed mobility scooter. Pure relaxation!
Your coronary calcium score comes back as 12 and your doctor arranges an urgent cath. Stat!
You realize that you actually feel better after sleeping with the CPAP machine your doctor recommended. Ouch!
Your CPAP machine breaks down but that’s fine you never liked the damn thing much anyway.
Your wife tells you the CPAP machine you’re using makes her think she has Darth Vader sleeping next to her. Oh no!
You discover that vanilla ice cream is the perfect consistency to slip through your gastric bypass. Caloric loophole unlocked!
It’s been 6 weeks since your last stent and you celebrate with a 24 oz ribeye and double loaded baked potato. Yummy!
Your cardiologist needs to amortize the new 3D echo machine and you get booked in for an unnecessary surveillance scan. Just to be safe!
You eat two bananas and watch a clip on Instagram warning you of fatal hyperkalemia. After rushing to the ER, you get a hefty bill – but hey better safe than sorry!
Doctors office BP is through the roof but you are adamant it’s the stress of finding parking in front – because how are you supposed to walk to the office from the far corners of the parking lot!?
The medical team tell strict NPO prior to a test but you secretly sneak a jelly donut in the bathroom before starting the procedure. Well done!
Your cardiologist brings up ORBITA trial and you fire them for gaslighting you, and hire an interventionist instead who isn’t afraid of balloons and stents. Finally!
Your angiogram has to be postponed because the cath lab team is busy eating free burritos brought by a device rep. It’s worth the wait!
When doctor tells you to exercise, you get a passive foot vibration pad instead that, after seeing on Instagram that it’s better than exercise. Smart move!
Your home BP recording machine tells you the rhythm is “irregular”. You panic and end up admitted for telemetry and troponins “just to be safe”. Close call!
You pop 3 nitroglycerins for heartburn after eating a few spicy burritos and your BP collapses – you hit the carpet!
Your Holter electrode peels off in the bath. Hospital orders a 30-day wireless telemetry patch to protect revenue!
You buy “Heart Smart” oat clusters packed with 42 grams of high-fructose corn syrup. Eating clean!
You break the strict 6-hour bedrest after a femoral access cath to use the real toilet. Say hello to a grapefruit-sized hematoma!
You quit smoking by switching to an industrial-strength nicotine vape you bought online. Your BP reaches an all-time high!
First doctor suggested lifestyle change – outrageous! Second doctor agrees to insert two drug-eluting stents right away. That’s the spirit!
You buy EDTA online which you mix in your coffee to clean out the coros. The hypocalcemia doesn’t kill you but the hospital bill almost does! Oops!
Generic Ozempic is flowing into the country from Brazil and India – oh no, prices come down!
Lobby groups in Washington circumvents the trans fat ban by calling them “partially hydrogenated oils” – you celebrate with cookies
Hospital kitchen bans fruits and vegetables to cut costs, replacing them with salted ham broth. Arteries clamp shut!
Cath lab procedural volume is down 18% this quarter. Elective diagnostic cath suddenly approved for all patients and indications!
Pharma rep brings the cath lab 6 dozen gourmet glazed donuts to promote a $2,000/month lipid drug. Breakfast is served!
Smartwatch firmware update flags normal breathing variation in HR as “arrhythmia” and suddenly patients are lining up outside clinic!
Salt lobby in Washington finally manages to block sodium warnings on food. Vascular trees all over America tighten in solidarity!
Annual cardiology meeting agrees to ignore ISCHEMIA trial entirely. Full metal jackets for everyone!
New outpatient clinic offers complimentary valet parking 12 feet from the door. Daily steps drop to single digits!
Hospital lab upgrades to the 8th UDMI with femtogram-sensitive troponin assays. Suddenly everyone has myocardial injury!
Hospital cafeteria installs bottomless 44 oz fountain soda dispensers and suddenly patients are refusing all fasting blood tests!
Generic statin prices drop to $3 / month but fortunately Big Pharma fights back by launching proprietary injectables at $2,000 per dose!
Hospital opens a fast-track bariatric surgery center. Everyone’s behavioral metabolic excess is fixed with laparoscopic staplers!
Equipment lease needs extending so an administrative memo mandates routine screening echo for all – in and outpatients!
Pharmacy automated BP cuff reads 178 / 102 after hauling 3 cases of soda. Walk-in clinic reaps the windfall!
Agricultural subsidies make high-fructose corn syrup cheaper than tap water. Snack aisles across the nation overflow!
Hospital risk managers mandate continuous telemetry for all admissions – zero beds left for STEMIs!
Hospital prints glossy Mediterranean Diet pamphlets and stacks them right next to those yummy deep-fried cafeteria nuggets. Terrible!
Health system launches a door-to-balloon speed competition. Patients are ballooned in 22 min before anyone takes a medical history!
Online supply chain shortage wipes out non-prescription red yeast rice. Patients are forced to take cheap, proven statins. Tragic!
Local burger franchise sponsors the hospital 5k healthy run. Free bacon double cheeseburgers for participants at the finish line!
Utilization committee masters 23-hour observation billing. Mild acid reflux successfully billed $7,500 in facility fees.
Hospital terminates the outpatient cardiac rehab program to finance an executive mahogany boardroom.
Direct-to-consumer TV ads convince the nation that stairs causing breathlessness is a balloon emergency. ER volume explodes!
Local city council repeals restrictions on commercial trans fats. Industrial bakeries celebrate with hydrogenated bliss!
New consensus finally brings down normal blood pressure to 100 / 60 mmHg, and the whole nation is hypertensive overnight!
CCU fills 100% of its beds with stable stent checks. Critical STEMI and shock cases need to be diverted elsewhere!
Global Healthcare Policy Shift: Ministry of Health convenes international summit. National health policy regime rotates!
WHO International Healthcare Accord: Global macro-health policy framework enacted. National health policy regime rotates!
